disclosures.text: Controlled synthetic source replay / NOT_ATTESTED. Population and published completeness are UNVERIFIED; official activation is UNAVAILABLE.
Manage owns eligibility and publication. Report preserves all three assessments and does not evaluate thresholds or manufacture approvals.
Membership reason_code is only the first reason. EligibilityReasons preserves every failure and unknown occurrence; occurrences are not unique excluded members.
EVALUATED_ONLY retains a proposal and missing-observation UNKNOWN cases. Approval, publication and membership history are unavailable for that variant; no receipt is inferred.
History retains original inclusive revision intervals. Selected month gaps are not filled; same-month policy diffs are not cross-month history. Cleared cash alone does not imply re-entry.
Ratios are source decimal ratios, not return percentages. Money, portfolio counts, event counts and booleans remain distinct. Raw decimal spelling and nulls remain retained.

no_reasons.statement: All captured assessment reason arrays for this month are empty; no applicable reason occurrences.
